description: DEP-06 §Enter: the accused operator never signs a DisputeEnter on its own ledger, and a fork a node opened on a ledger it operates is void. `proof_cases`: node `us` holds a ledger whose current operator is `operator` and receives a VERIFIED fraud proof accusing `accused`; expect whether it enters a dispute (opens a fork) and how many updates it signs doing so (its DisputeEnter). A node enters only when the proof accuses the ledger's current operator and `us` is neither the accused nor the operator. `fork_cases`: a fork record held at startup; `fate` is `void` (a fork of a ledger we operate: never published, never yielded), `publish` (our live fork: its tail is republished, whatever has happened on its base since; a later QuorumBegin past the fork point does not stop it, since the accused or a colluding quorum can append one), or `not_ours` (another member's fork, or not Disputed/Armed). `fork_point` and `base_quorum_begin` are context and never change the fate. Keys are names; `null` means the record is not held. From the signet soak, 2026-11-19/20: ref4, operator of 5effb9e8, forked its own ledger at 432509 on a QuorumExpired proof against itself and later signed the main chain's 432510; a restart republished the fork and its members proved Equivocation.

proof_cases.name: operator receives a QuorumExpired proof against itself (ref4, 5effb9e8, 2026-11-19T21:46:18Z)
operator receives an Equivocation proof against itself
operator receives a proof on its own ledger naming another key
member receives a QuorumExpired proof against the operator
member receives an Equivocation proof against the operator
member receives a proof accusing itself
former operator, custody moved to w, receives the old proof against itself
new custodian receives the old proof against its predecessor
ledger not held: nothing to judge against

fork_cases.name: ref4's self-fork of 5effb9e8 at 432509, left on disk (republished 2026-11-20T06:26:57Z)
a self-fork with no later QuorumBegin is void too
member fork, live, no later QuorumBegin
member fork past a later QuorumBegin: still republished (the accused can append one)
member expiry fork past a later QuorumBegin: still republished (the stand-down, not startup, ends it)
won and promoted fork: the base is this fork
